# Go API reference

These pages list the exported identifiers of every Go package in the module `github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium`, generated from the source comments by [gomarkdoc](https://github.com/princjef/gomarkdoc). Almost all packages live under `internal/`, so other Go modules cannot import them. The pages are for people who read or extend the server. To use segredium from your own code, talk to it with an AWS SDK. See [API compatibility](/compatibility).

## Command

- [`cmd/segredium`](/api-reference/go/cmd/segredium/): Command segredium is a self-hosted, AWS Secrets Manager API-compatible server.

## API operations

- [`internal/ops`](/api-reference/go/internal/ops/): Package ops implements every Secrets Manager operation, one file per operation, each registering itself with api.Register from init().

## Packages

- [`internal/api`](/api-reference/go/internal/api/): Package api is the HTTP front end: the AWS JSON 1.1 protocol for the secretsmanager service.
- [`internal/apierr`](/api-reference/go/internal/apierr/): Package apierr defines the Secrets Manager (AWS JSON 1.1) error types and their HTTP status.
- [`internal/app`](/api-reference/go/internal/app/): Package app wires configuration, storage, the API server and background workers together.
- [`internal/awsjson`](/api-reference/go/internal/awsjson/): Package awsjson implements the AWS JSON 1.1 wire conventions used by Secrets Manager.
- [`internal/ca`](/api-reference/go/internal/ca/): Package ca is segredium's built-in local certificate authority.
- [`internal/cli`](/api-reference/go/internal/cli/): Package cli is segredium's subcommand registry (serve.go, ca.go).
- [`internal/config`](/api-reference/go/internal/config/): Package config loads segredium's YAML configuration with SEGREDIUM_* env overrides.
- [`internal/model`](/api-reference/go/internal/model/): Package model holds the stored shape of a secret.
- [`internal/peercred`](/api-reference/go/internal/peercred/): Package peercred identifies local TCP callers without trusting HTTP headers.
- [`internal/purge`](/api-reference/go/internal/purge/): Package purge removes secrets whose recovery windows have expired.
- [`internal/sm`](/api-reference/go/internal/sm/): Package sm holds what every operation shares: dependencies, ARNs, secret-id resolution and common validation.
- [`internal/store`](/api-reference/go/internal/store/): Package store defines the persistence contract.
- [`internal/store/filestore`](/api-reference/go/internal/store/filestore/): Package filestore keeps an in-memory index backed by one encrypted file per secret.
- [`internal/store/memstore`](/api-reference/go/internal/store/memstore/): Package memstore is the in-memory reference implementation of store.Store.
- [`internal/store/storetest`](/api-reference/go/internal/store/storetest/): Package storetest is the conformance suite for store.Store.
- [`internal/versions`](/api-reference/go/internal/versions/): Package versions implements Secrets Manager staging labels and version retention.
